text:
You were saying words

intimate, silent.


Words that are spoken

from love to love,

from one mouth to another mouth.


The secret poem

was made for everyone,

the small words

memorable, blessed.


The daily feats,

illusions of the day,

the smallest things;

shared words,

useful, generous.


The secret poem

was made for everyone,

the small words

—others I shall not say—

will last like rocks.

translation.title: You Were Saying Words...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the small shared words as the durable substance of the poem.
